title: Molecular testing of carrion flies for rabbit calicivirus detection
author: Robyn Hall
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ux7exrn
materials: As described in https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/29226567 . Kit : OneStep Ahead RT-PCR Kit (Qiagen) Primers : Templates : NTC (nfH 2 O), fly RNA, strain-specific positive control Dilute RNAs 1/10 in nuclease-free water. Prepare four RT-PCR mastermixes - one per primer pair. Add 9 µL of mastermix to respective PCR tubes. Add 1 µL of diluted RNA template to respective tubes. Cycling: 50 °C for 00:10:00 95 °C for 00:05:00 40 cycles of: 95 °C for 00:00:10 63 °C for 00:00:20 72 °C for 00:00:10 Final extension at 72 °C for 00:02:00 Hold at 4 °C Run PCRs on a 1-1.5% agarose gel at 80-100 V for 30-60 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare and Set Up Fly Traps
steps.instruction: Decontaminate the trap and set it for fly collection.

substeps.instruction: Soak trap in 10% household bleach for at least 30 minutes, then rinse with water.
Place attractant in a specimen jar covered with a gauze swab.
Place trap in collection location for one to seven days.
Freeze entire trap at -20 °C to immobilise flies.

steps.title: Collect and Process Fly Tissue
steps.instruction: Transfer flies to tubes and prepare for dry weight calculation.

substeps.instruction: Transfer >48 mg of fly tissue (approx. five large calliphorid flies e.g., C. augur, C. stygia or seven small flies e.g., Chrysomya varipes) to a pre-weighed 1.8 ml tube containing 1mm glass beads.
Process negative control flies in parallel for each batch of testing.
Transfer remaining flies to storage containers at -20 °C.
Decontaminate trap before reuse.
Loosen lids on tubes containing flies and place in freeze-drying chamber.
Freeze-dry overnight and weigh tube to calculate dry fly tissue weight.

steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Work Area
steps.instruction: Prepare the workspace and necessary buffers for RNA extraction.

substeps.instruction: Decontaminate work area prior to commencing RNA extraction.
Prepare DNase I by adding 275 µL of nuclease-free water and 5 µL of Blue Dye to one vial of lyophilised DNase I; store at -20 °C.
Set heat-block to 70 °C.
Prepare aliquots of: a) homogenisation buffer containing 20 µl.ml-1 of 1-Thioglycerol (chill before use), b) lysis buffer, and c) DNase I.

steps.title: Homogenise and Lyse Samples
steps.instruction: Homogenise fly tissue and prepare the lysate.

substeps.instruction: Homogenise samples using a Precellys 24-dual tissue homogeniser (Bertin technologies).
Spin homogenised samples briefly to collect material at the bottom of the tube.
Add 10 µL of homogenisation buffer containing 1-Thioglycerol per mg of dry fly tissue volumes (minimum 200 μl).
Heat samples at 70 °C for 00:02:00 and allow to cool for 00:01:00.
Mix homogenate (minimum 200 μl) with an equal volume of lysis buffer by vortexing for 00:00:15.

steps.title: Extract RNA using Maxwell RSC
steps.instruction: Perform automated RNA extraction using the Maxwell RSC instrument.

substeps.instruction: Snap cartridges into position on the deck tray and centre them.
Remove foil from cartridges.
Place an LEV Plunger in well #8 of each cartridge.
Add 10 µL of DNase I to well #4 of each cartridge.
Label one 0.5 ml elution tube per sample and add 50 µL of nuclease-free water to the bottom of each tube; place elution tubes into position on the deck tray.
Add 400 µL of homogenate/lysis buffer mix to well #1.
Place deck tray into Maxwell RSC instrument, open elution tube lids, and run the instrument.
Store extracted RNAs at -80 °C immediately after extraction.
Dispose of chemical waste according to local guidelines.

steps.title: Perform RT-qPCR Detection
steps.instruction: Detect rabbit calicivirus using SensiFAST™ SYBR® No-ROX Kit and specific primers.

substeps.instruction: Prepare RT-qPCR mastermix using Primers GI_qRTPCR_Fw (5’- TTGACRTACGCCCTGTGGGACC-3’) and GI_qRTPCR_Rv (5’- TCAGACATAAGARAAGCCATTRGYTG-3’).
Add 9 µL of mastermix to respective wells of a 96 well PCR plate.
Add 1 µL of RNA template to respective wells, including: fly RNAs in duplicate, RHDV standards in duplicate (10^1 to 10^7), NTC (nfH2O) in duplicate, and positive control in duplicate.
Run cycling: 45 °C for 00:10:00; 95 °C for 00:05:00; then 40 cycles of (95 °C for 00:00:10, 63 °C for 00:00:40, 78 °C for 00:00:10 with acquisition).
Perform melt curve from 65 °C to 95 °C with an increment of 0.5 °C and acquisition.
